items.text: Config shell parity (B5) — Help uses the split-shell pattern with chip navigation; Bookmarks and Collections share normalized row rhythm inside fused surfaces.
Flattened nested cards — Tags and Backups use divided rows inside fused surfaces; Theme Colors subtabs match the General layer switcher; Help link/code styles stay scoped to the help surface.
Theme dirty state (B10) — unsaved Theme changes rely on the save row only; local has-unsaved styling removed from Save colors.
Reduced motion (C15) — broader prefers-reduced-motion coverage for skeleton loaders, spotlight tours, and chip navigation.
Unified chrome — shared header chip tokens; clearer toolbar hierarchy; lighter card rows; footer buttons follow theme surface tokens instead of custom accent tints.
Toolbar modals — What's new (★), recent, and help modals share search-overlay chrome; search anchors above the toolbar with matching width.
Empty states & polish — clearer smart-collection empties; page-level empty chrome on Modern/Glass; tag-filter recovery actions; page icons in the overview overlay; shared layout radii tokens.
Recent modal (D8) — rank, recency badge, and open count per bookmark on the current page.
Status-row hover (D12) — hover and selection use shared --bookmark-row-* tokens across Classic, Modern, and Glass.
Status loading default — Show status loading indicator is off unless explicitly enabled.
Fresh-install toolbar — new installs show Search, Commands, Finders, What's new (★), and + Add bookmark only; Recent and cheat sheet stay hidden until enabled in Config → General → Header & buttons.
Classic default — onboarding keeps Classic layout; Modern/Glass show a one-time early-beta notice. Classic config header stays separate from save row and tabs (v2026.07.01.3 — C10 reverted).
README, MANUAL, Config Help & What's new — release notes for v2026.07.05; Help recap and locales updated (EN/NL/DE/FR); Classic C10 rollback wording corrected.
Playwright — config tab consistency retains Classic C10 separate-header test; dashboard recent-modal and config Help-shell coverage.
